inland.t: Where the dunes meet the sea
inland.s: Khor Al Adaid by 4x4. One of the few places on earth where high dunes run into the sea. On UNESCO's Tentative List.
inland.short: the dunes at Khor Al Adaid

whale.s: One of the world's largest. Watched from the deck: never touched, never fed, no swimming.
whale.op: Catamaran from Al Ruwais · marine biologist on board

zubarah.t: The pearling town under the sand
zubarah.s: Al Zubarah, a World Heritage Site since 2013. Its 18th-century story told on site by audio.
zubarah.op: Story walk · audio in 9 languages · transfer

stars.s: Camp by the Inland Sea with a fire and the Milky Way, back in Doha for breakfast.

turtle.s: Hawksbill nesting on the north coast, only on nights our conservation partners open it.

mangrove.s: Kayak the green channels of the north coast with herons overhead.

dhow.s: The skyline from the water with Arabic coffee and dates.

mia.s: Fourteen centuries of craft in a building that sits on the sea.

nmoq.s: The desert rose building, and Qatar's story from seabed to skyline.

souq.s: Lanterns, grills, spice stalls and falcons. A guided tasting walk.

spa.s: Infinity pool, hammam ritual and mint tea with the dunes on the horizon.

rest.s: Pool, nap or wander. Your call.
